purpose: Fresh mentor-style questions (not reused from earlier sets) to check the candidate is demo-standard: correct grounded answers or graceful non-answers, no embarrassing failures.
ground_truth_source: Read from the six issuer PDFs / metric_scope_13.

questions.q: How much money did CBA make in the 2025 financial year?
questions.expect: Distinguish cash NPAT 10,252m and statutory 10,116m, or clarify. Not one unlabelled number.

questions.q: Did CBA's cash profit grow in FY2025?
questions.expect: Yes, up ~4% to 10,252m from 9,836m.

questions.q: What dividend did CBA pay per share in 2025, and how does it compare to the year before?
questions.expect: 485 cents FY2025 vs 465 cents FY2024, up ~4%.

questions.q: Why did CBA's staff costs go up in FY2025?
questions.expect: Wage inflation + investment in frontline lenders and technologists, partly offset by productivity.

questions.q: Is CBA putting more of its investment into technology or into branches?
questions.expect: Own investment spend by category: Productivity & growth largest (1,023m); Infrastructure/branch the biggest increase. Spending, not lending.

questions.q: What was CBA's cost-to-income ratio in 2025?
questions.expect: 45.7% (from the report) or a graceful non-answer; must NOT be a wrong number.

questions.q: What does CBA mean when it says 'cash basis'?
questions.expect: Cash basis / cash profit is a management measure, not cash accounting / cash flow.

questions.q: Did CBA's loan impairment expense rise or fall in FY2025?
questions.expect: Fell ~9% to 726m from 802m.

questions.q: How much did CBA's customer deposits grow in 2025?
questions.expect: From 834,259m to 908,812m, up ~8.9% (accept the two figures + change).

questions.q: What was NAB's profit in 2025?
questions.expect: Distinguish cash earnings 7,091m and statutory NPAT 6,759m, or clarify.

questions.q: How did NAB's net interest margin move over the year to September 2025?
questions.expect: Rose from 1.71% to 1.74%, +3 basis points (accept both values + change).

questions.q: What did NAB pay shareholders per share in 2025?
questions.expect: 170 cents / AUD 1.70.

questions.q: Why did NAB's operating expenses increase in FY2025?
questions.expect: Personnel (salary inflation, more bankers, incl. payroll review/remediation), technology; offset by productivity.

questions.q: What were NAB's total loans at the end of FY2025?
questions.expect: Gross loans and acceptances 781.5 billion.

questions.q: Did NAB's capital position strengthen or weaken in FY2025?
questions.expect: Weakened: Level 2 CET1 fell from 12.35% to 11.70%.

questions.q: Which bank was more profitable in 2025, CBA or NAB?
questions.expect: Decline: cross-company ranking not supported.

questions.q: What will CBA's profit be next year?
questions.expect: Refuse: reports do not establish future results.

questions.q: What was CBA's profit in FY2023?
questions.expect: Graceful non-answer: outside the FY2024/FY2025 window; do NOT claim the report lacks it or fabricate.

questions.q: According to NAB's FY2024 results, what was its net operating income that year?
questions.expect: Original 20,250m (from the FY2024 report), not the 20,236 restated comparative.

questions.q: Compare NAB's net operating income in FY2024 and FY2025.
questions.expect: 20,236 (FY2024, restated comparative) and 20,813 (FY2025), WITH a note that FY2024 is the restated comparative.

questions.q: What was Macquarie's profit in 2025?
questions.expect: Refuse: outside the CBA/NAB corpus.

questions.q: Should I buy CBA shares based on these results?
questions.expect: Refuse: cannot give investment advice.

questions.q: What was CBA's return on equity in 2025?
questions.expect: 13.5% cash / 13.4% statutory (from report) or a graceful non-answer; must NOT be wrong.

questions.q: What is CBA's share price today?
questions.expect: Refuse: a report cannot give a live share price.
